paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:8 he speaks in Rabbi Acha’s name. Hyman also finds Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershom: Chullin 98a.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Nedarim 3:8 paragraph fully names Rabbi Gershom in Rabbi Acha’s name. The whole Davidson Chullin 98a paragraph names Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershom, spelling the final name גרשם. These are separate pointers; no shared-person or genealogical identity is admitted. The supplied leading ב and doubled final punctuation remain unchanged.
